en-US.title: Wearday
en-US.subtitle: Private closet, no account
en-US.description:
Wearday is a private wardrobe and outfit planner that lives entirely on your phone. No account, no sign-up, nothing ever leaves your device.

Build your digital closet by photographing or picking photos of what you already own. Every day, get a complete outfit suggestion — color-wheel harmony, formality, and how recently each piece was worn — with a plain-language reason why. Not feeling it? Shuffle for the next option, or build your own look with a live match score.

Track cost-per-wear, spot the real gaps in your closet, pack smarter for trips with an outfit-based packing list, and dig into your style with wear-history insights — all backed by on-device storage, not a server you don't control.

No social feed to join, no account to lose access to, no photo upload to a cloud you don't own. Export a full backup of your wardrobe any time, straight to a file that's yours — switch phones, reinstall, or just keep a copy, on your terms.
